description: MoPC-HR original attention ResNet, explicit WiSig256 single-record input adaptation; scratchsourceE200/midPL+concat, cleanL_s old6 prototypes afterfreeze; directAC nativepaper objective5classsessions20epochs; originalGroup1 fourseed allcapsules plusMIX01 KN.

data.representation: eq1 first256 float64 raw -> original FP32 unit-RMS -> fixed practical residual/post_sync/no additional EQ
data.split_id: read exact existing K/N split IDs
data.source_target_overlap_policy: same source physical roles;target opens only B/C current support;query never fit

permissions.claim_scope: Author attentionResNet with declared WiSig256 input adapter; paper-equation C loss semantics, not exact original paper dataset reproduction. Native C uses NK new labels only and no targetold labels; no generic encoder substitution.

checkpoint.initialization: scratch per seed, no pretrained/resume/teacher/target weight inheritance
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: existing validated Group1 source contract + trisig_source.validate_done rechecks complete original source recipe
checkpoint.selection_rule: sourcefixedE200; finalA frozen before L_s-only6x256prototypes and no-query realcheckpoint smoke; no V/target selection

metrics_plan.primary: C old/new macroaccuracy/H/F1/floor, paired native directAC vs frozen R42 on originalGroup1 scope; source andtargetcost actual
metrics_plan.success: Complete preregisterednativecomparison; do not promise performance or selectfromtarget scores
metrics_plan.secondary: PerRX/day/scene/TX/pool/episode/modelseed, nativeA0/C, PLacceptance andexposure, sessions/steps/updatedparams/time/memory; noB forMoPC
metrics_plan.scientific_source_rule: A scratchE200 Adam.001; PL101-200 tau.95 w1; concat.68 L; C5classes/session20epochs SGD.01 paperloss, currentnewSUP only
